text: しゃり　しゃり　いてだきのどうくつの　こおりを　けずって　つくった　かきごおり　つめたくて　うまい！
note: かきごおり (kakigōri) is a Japanese summer treat of finely shaved ice topped with flavoured syrup, eaten with a spoon. The English game turned it into a 'slushie'.
claim: Kakigōri is a Japanese dessert of shaved ice flavoured with syrup, traditionally eaten in summer.

check.quote: Kakigōri (かき氷) is a Japanese shaved ice dessert flavored with syrup and a sweetener, often condensed milk. ... During the hot summer months, kakigōri is sold virtually everywhere in Japan. ... a spoon is almost always used to eat it.
